decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established yogurt and dessert business, it is likely to meet at least modest aspiration levels and a German organic dairy firm would usually allow more time before dropping such a low-distance product.

Because it was highlighted on the home page as a flagship launch, management is likely to view it as strategically important and give it strong support unless results clearly fall far below aspirations.

A semi-hard cheese wheel fits the firm's core cheese capabilities and farmer-based supply, so under behavioral decision making it would probably be retained while management learns about its market acceptance.

Although a multi-model spicy cheese line uses more shelf and coordination resources, it still builds directly on established cheese competencies and is likely to be kept unless early sales are distinctly disappointing.

This mild creamy soft cheese appears to complete the range rather than define strategy, so it faces somewhat more pruning risk, but the fit with the firm's organic cheese offer still favors retention.

Washed-rind soft cheese is somewhat more specialized and uncertain in demand, yet it remains close enough to the firm's core business that an independent organic producer would likely continue it for now rather than exit quickly.
